home.what.eyebrow: A simple experience for complex situations
home.what.title: What is VERA?
home.what.p1: VERA is a conversational AI assistant that supports LATAM Bank customers in card disputes: unrecognized charges, improper fees, lost or stolen cards and transfers made under deception.
home.what.p2: It verifies with bank data, explains in plain language, records every claim with its rule and deadline, and contains risk by blocking the card only when the customer confirms.
home.what.card: Operational efficiency with a warm, human experience.
home.how.sub: VERA guides the customer from the first question to a filed case, so the analyst never starts from scratch.
home.how.s1.d: The customer explains what happened in their own words.
home.how.s2.d: VERA locates the charge among their transactions.
home.how.s3.d: It confirms key facts with simple questions.
home.how.s4.d: Shows the rule and its source, and the deadline when the rules set one.
home.how.s5.d: It files the case with the customer's confirmation.
home.benefits.title2: Peace of mind for your customers.
home.benefits.sub: Every conversation ends in an orderly, traceable case ready for human review.
home.b1.d: Clear answers and guidance at every step.
home.b2.d: Cases separate verified and declared facts.
home.b3.d: Every rule with its source. The deadline, only where the rules set one.
home.b4.d: Customers can ask for a person at any time.
home.final.title: See VERA serving LATAM Bank customers.
home.final.body: Sign in with the account we sent you, pick a demo customer and follow a dispute from start to finish, all the way to the analyst console.

int.title: A solution that adapts to your ecosystem.
int.sub: VERA integrates with the systems your bank already runs through standard interfaces. The capabilities the bank already has become the agent's tools, and AI adoption is built on what already exists.
int.i1.d: Any system that exposes its data through an API connects with an adapter, without touching the rules or the conversation.
int.i2.t: The AI model is swapped by configuration.
int.i2.d: Rules, permissions and traceability belong to the bank and stay in place.
int.i3.t: A new country is a new policy.
int.i3.d: Its regulatory framework is loaded as rules, without changing the system.
int.note: Today VERA runs on pseudonymized LATAM Bank data, Anthropic's Claude with its own fallback classifier, and cases recorded and re-read in its own database.
int.dTitle: How VERA connects with the bank's systems
int.dDesc: VERA, surrounded by the bank's rules, connects with eight systems: customers and identity, transactions, cards, cases, service queues, audit, AI model and channels.
int.s.tx.d: finds the charge and reviews the others
int.s.card.d: blocks only with the customer's confirmation
int.s.case.d: records a single case and re-reads it
int.s.queue.d: hands the full case to the analyst
int.s.model.d: interprets the message; swapped by configuration
int.s.chan.d: the web, the bank's app or any channel it already has
